description: Add or overwrite a colour keyframe on a fill track. Targets a leaf (shapes.<id>, image.<id>, video.<id>, group.<id>). The canvas backdrop is the pinned is_background image_layer (the literal 'background.canvas' is accepted as a synonym for its element id). The value is a Fill — adjacent keyframes crossfade stop-by-stop. 30 fps; frame is 0-indexed.

easing.description: Interpolation to the next keyframe. Default linear.

elementId.description: Element id (shapes/image/video/group prefixed). The pinned is_background image_layer is the canvas backdrop; 'background.canvas' is also accepted as a synonym.

frame.description: Frame number, 0-indexed. 30 fps so frame 30 = 1 second.

projectId.description: Opaque project id (a v4 UUID, from list_projects/create_project). Selects which existing project this call mutates.

value.description: Either '#rrggbb' (promoted to solid) or a Fill object: {type:"solid",color} / {type:"linear",stops:[{pos:0..1,color}],angle?} / {type:"radial",stops:[{pos:0..1,color}],cx?,cy?,radius?}. Adjacent keyframes crossfade the gradient stop-by-stop.

name: add_color_keyframe

outputSchema.description: The result envelope every Morpha tool returns.

data.description: The payload, shaped by the tool.

editorUrl.description: Opens this project in the editor.

note.description: What to do next when not ready.

status.description: For cache-backed readers: whether the answer was ready.
